chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The sanctuary of the grave of al-Husayn, peace be upon him, extends five parasangs from the four sides of the grave."

key_terms.حَرِيمُ: the protected sacred precinct or sanctuary
key_terms.فَرَاسِخَ: parasangs; a classical unit of distance
key_terms.قَبْرِ: grave; the burial site being discussed

ai.seo_question: What is the extent of the sanctuary of the grave of al-Husayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the extent of the sacred precinct surrounding the grave of al-Husayn عليه السلام. It indicates a defined sanctity attached to his burial place and its surrounding area.
